verdicts.reason: Both use the same leaderboard layout: a two-line headline left of centre and a small cat cluster on the right, with a wide empty purple gap between them. Neither puts the headline and image on a clear shared grid, and the cats shrink to a tiny thumbnail that loses most of the original's charm. A's cat cluster floats a few pixels above the bottom edge, so it looks pasted on. B keeps the cats bleeding off the bottom edge as in the original and has slightly larger headline text, so B is marginally more faithful.
